findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 131 requests to 32 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 8.7 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 5.4 MB (62%) came from third-party domains, 1.2 MB of it from services classified as tracking (86 requests).

18 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), bidswitch.net (Iponweb (BidSwitch), advertising), casalemedia.com (Index Exchange, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), doubleverify.com (DoubleVerify, advertising), dv.tech (DoubleVerify, advertising), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising).
33 cookies were set by third-party domains (58 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Strict-Transport-Security header.
